summary: Debug and release both pass 97 framework checks + 8 tool checks on Windows with zero warnings. CoreText parity holds at 1.122/255 mean. Added PolymerText extras (GDEF, UAX#14, fallback, variable fonts, COLR/CPAL, 1/4-px GlyphCache quantization), PolymerAudio extras (ALAC, AIFF, 64-bit DSP, MP4/ReplayGain metadata), PolymerUI/Design polish (ViewTree.record, ScrollViewReader + PScrollBar, onDisappear + CommandRegistry unmount, theme-driven PanelLook/TextInputLook, CustomizeModel size persistence), and CLI tooling (polymer diff, polymer bench, --customize, design.glassContrast).

done.title: Text
done.detail: Polymer reads fonts and draws text itself (CoreText mean 1.122/255), with GDEF, UAX#14 line breaking, fallback chains, variable fonts, COLR/CPAL color emoji, and optional 1/4-px GlyphCache quantization.

done.title: Drawing
done.detail: Shapes, images (PNG and JPEG), blur and glass, drawn on the processor and on the graphics card with the same result, plus automated WCAG contrast-on-glass checks (DESIGN 11.4).

done.title: Views and layout
done.detail: Stacks (including Spacer minLength), grids, lists of any length, ScrollViewReader + ScrollViewProxy, .allowsHitTesting, .onDisappear, PointerStyle, written the same way as Apple's SwiftUI.

done.title: Input
done.detail: Clicks, double and triple clicks, dragging, keyboard, text fields (including Ctrl+Y redo), right-click & keyboard context menus, popovers, sheets (no auto-focus), and keyboard shortcuts.

done.title: Accessibility
done.detail: Every screen can describe itself, the way a screen reader sees it.

done.title: Real windows
done.detail: Polymer opens real windows on Windows, drawn by the graphics card via ViewTree.record() without CPU rasterization, with system clipboard and IME.

done.title: Tools for agents
done.detail: polymer render, describe, diff, bench (release layout+record p50 0.03 ms, software raster p50 8.68 ms), --customize, check, check-tools, status, log, activity, help.

inProgress.title: Moving Meimei onto Polymer
inProgress.detail: A new I2SCore module holds the track and album model and reads and writes the same library file as Meimei, with checks. Next: reading the real library file, then the Albums page.

inProgress.title: Design system
inProgress.detail: The pgr look as ready-made parts wired to theme tokens (PanelLook/TextInputLook, live PScrollBar, CommandRegistry unmount cleanup, CustomizeModel width/height persistence). Light-mode Material presets still need owner sign-off.

inProgress.title: Audio engine
inProgress.detail: Pure-Swift WAV, FLAC, MP3, AIFF/AIFC, ALAC/M4A with tags/cover art/ReplayGain, 64-bit DSP (EQ, BS.1770 loudness, true peak, limiter, crossfader, crossfeed, dither), and gapless playback. WASAPI output still needs live-speaker verification.

inProgress.title: Windows integration
inProgress.detail: Screen readers in real windows, wiring PointerStyle to Win32 cursor shapes, and keyboard context menu hook in Win32Window.

next.title: The i2s Albums page
next.detail: The first real screen of the music player, built on Polymer.

next.title: Playback end to end
next.detail: Play music in i2s through the speakers, checked against real MP3 files.

next.title: Mac
next.detail: Compile and check the Mac parts on a Mac, and draw and play sound there.

next.title: Apps in the polymer command
next.detail: Let the command draw and drive an app's own screens, not only the samples.

waitingForOwner.title: Look of the design system
waitingForOwner.detail: Please approve or change the proposed look: blue accent, three dark greys, square corners, solid panels instead of glass, a thin blue focus outline, and the control, row, toolbar and sidebar sizes (plus light-mode Material presets).

waitingForOwner.title: How menus behave
waitingForOwner.detail: Right-click menus open as soon as the button is pressed (as on a Mac), at the pixel under the pointer. Say if you prefer them on release (as on Windows).

waitingForOwner.title: Look of other new parts
waitingForOwner.detail: Menus, popovers, sheets, text fields and pressed glass still use placeholder looks; Docs/HANDOFF.md lists the questions.
